description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 直播资源的唯一标识ID，传空值时，系统自动生成36位随机UUID字符串。
description.en: The unique ID of the live stream resource. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically generates a 36-character random UUID string.

title.zh: 根据直播唯一标识查看观看时长
title.en: Query watch duration by live stream ID

descriptions.zh: 根据直播资源的唯一标识ID查询普通延迟观看时长，低延迟观看时长。
descriptions.en: Queries the standard-latency watch duration and low-latency watch duration by the unique ID of a live stream resource.
